scope: all m=220 degree-11 anchors with r=t-w=3, equivalently S(v)=129
relaxation: For each fixed A/B pair, every A-side global degree label is independently relaxed to any value 11..17. Only the exact aggregate cross-edge total implied by S(v)=129 is retained; B-side degree labels and column degrees are completely relaxed.
conclusion: In any hypothetical 220-edge R(4,6,36) graph, every degree-11 vertex satisfies r(v)=t(v)-w(v)>=4. Hence the degree-11 induced subgraph has minimum degree at least 4, so n11 cannot be 1,2,3,4,or5.
crosscheck: The separately fixed-P3 n11=5 row search enumerated 22,950 actual P3 placements across the same local strata and independently returned 22,950 UNSAT, 0 TIMEOUT, 0 SAT.
source_catalogs: McKay complete R(3,6,11) catalogue strata A25/A26 and complete R(4,5,24) strata B116/B117; source SHA-256 values were authenticated in the earlier m219 r4 workflow.
